title: Voice audition
description: A sculpted three-voice tray separates narrator selection from tactile playback controls.
useCase: Compare the same line across available system voices before choosing a narrator.
interaction: Select a narrator or press its play key to audition the shared phrase.
reducedMotion: Playback state stays legible through a static pressed key; animated bars stop. Real speech still plays on request.
limitations: Uses up to three available system voices, preferring different available English locales. Voice names, quality, availability and word-boundary events vary by browser/device. Bars indicate playback, not measured amplitude.
look: Soft neumorphic grey-blue tray of three rounded voice rows with raised circular play keys; the selected row sits inset with a blue indicator dot.
motion: Pressing a play key sinks it 1 px into an inset shadow; five blue bars pulse in a staggered 700 ms loop and the spoken word highlights on boundary events.
adapt: Playback is `preview`, which speaks `LINE` with `SpeechSynthesisUtterance` and sets `word` from `onboundary`; the bars are `.sf-va-levels` animated by `@keyframes sf-va-level` with `animationDelay` offsets. Replace `LINE` and the voice choice in `load`; bars are decorative, not amplitude.
